verdict.rationale: Source availability under an open license is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Unity's engine or editor source published under an open license. The only openness-related items are adjacent: a third-party plugin that is itself open source, the closed MCP distribution with no public repo, and community comparisons to open-source engines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
